targets.expr:
sum by (host_name, comment, mac_address, mac_vendor, active_address, address, address_lists, status) (sort_by_label_numeric(
label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(label_replace(mtik_exporter_dhcp_lease_info{routerboard_name="$node", active_address!=""},
"ip-part1", "$1", "address", "([0-9]{1,3})\\.(.+)"),
"ip-part2", "$2", "address", "([0-9]{1,3})\\.([0-9]{1,3})\\.(.+)"),
"ip-part3", "$3", "address", "([0-9]{1,3})\\.([0-9]{1,3})\\.([0-9]{1,3})\\.(.+)"),
"ip-part4", "$4", "address", "([0-9]{1,3})\\.([0-9]{1,3})\\.([0-9]{1,3})\\.([0-9]{1,3})"),
"ip-part1", "ip-part2", "ip-part3", "ip-part4"))

(mtik_exporter_connection_stats{routerboard_name="JP-RB5009"}) * on (src_address) group_right(src_address, dst_addresses) (label_replace(mtik_exporter_dhcp_lease_info{routerboard_name="JP-RB5009"}, "src_address", "$1", "address", "(.*)")) or on (src_address, dst_addresses) mtik_exporter_connection_stats{routerboard_name="JP-RB5009"}
sum by (comment, os, arch, root_dir, status) (mtik_exporter_container_running{routerboard_name="$node"})
sum by (name, configuration_ssid, channel, mac_address, master, tx_power) (mtik_exporter_wifi_interfaces_info{routerboard_name="$node"})

label_replace(
    label_replace(

        mtik_exporter_wifi_clients_signal_strength{routerboard_name="$node"} * on (mac_address) group_left(comment)
            mtik_exporter_dhcp_lease_info{routerboard_name="$node"}

        or on (mac_address)
        mtik_exporter_wifi_clients_signal_strength{routerboard_name="$node"},

    "display_name", "$1", "mac_address", "(.+)"),
"display_name", "$1", "comment", "(.+)")

label_replace(
    label_replace(
        rate(mtik_exporter_wifi_clients_rx_bytes_total{routerboard_name="$node"}[$__rate_interval]) * 8 *
            on (mac_address) group_left(comment)
            mtik_exporter_dhcp_lease_info{routerboard_name="$node"}
        
        or on (mac_address)
        rate(mtik_exporter_wifi_clients_rx_bytes_total{routerboard_name="$node"}[$__rate_interval]) * 8, 

    "display_name", "$1", "mac_address", "(.+)"),
"display_name", "$1", "comment", "(.+)")

label_replace(
    label_replace(
        -rate(mtik_exporter_wifi_clients_tx_bytes_total{routerboard_name="$node"}[$__rate_interval]) * 8 *
            on (mac_address) group_left(comment)
            mtik_exporter_dhcp_lease_info{routerboard_name="$node"}
        
        or on (mac_address)
        -rate(mtik_exporter_wifi_clients_tx_bytes_total{routerboard_name="$node"}[$__rate_interval]) * 8, 

    "display_name", "$1", "mac_address", "(.+)"),
"display_name", "$1", "comment", "(.+)")
